message.content: Based on the conversations provided, Li Hua plans to celebrate Chinese Lunar New Year at her place on January 18th. She invites WolfgangSchulz to join her celebrations, emphasizing the importance of enjoying "good food" and creating a festive atmosphere. Li Hua mentions that she will likely cook some traditional dishes and possibly decorate, indicating that she intends to host a gathering centered around the Lunar New Year celebration. WolfgangSchulz expresses his interest in joining, particularly mentioning his desire to make dumplings, which he considers a must for the New Year.
